description: This file defines the ModuleClass class for the 'Payslip' module in vtiger CRM, extending CRMEntity. It includes properties and methods for database interactions, list views, security, import/export, and module event handling.

classes.name: ModuleClass
classes.description: Represents the 'Payslip' module, managing database operations, list views, security, import/export, and module lifecycle events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleClass instance, setting column fields, database connection, and logging.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the current sort order for list views, considering request and session parameters.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves the current order by field for list views, considering default and session parameters.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder for custom save logic for the module.

methods.name: getQueryByModuleField
methods.description: Constructs a query based on module and field, used for popup searches.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query for retrieving list view records, including joins and security filters.

methods.name: getListViewSecurityParameter
methods.description: Generates security restrictions for list views based on user privileges.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates the SQL query for exporting records, considering permissions and filters.

methods.description: Initializes the object for importing data into the module.
